summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a 6-K detailing procedures for the redemption or conversion of its Class C preferred shares (PNC Shares), following a May 6, 2026 material fact. The first transaction involves up to BRL 4 billion in redemptions. The redemption value per PNC share equals the closing price of the company's common shares on the trading session before the board resolution date (D-1). Holders may elect a 1:1 conversion into common shares during a five-day election period; otherwise, shares are automatically redeemed. ADR holders are mandatorily redeemed. The board will approve the amount and communicate commencement. Watch for the board resolution and subsequent election period mechanics.
